proxy_definition.blocking_grade_proxy: CRITICAL + MAJOR. Reason: rounds 1-3 used a binary any-severity rule (every finding failed the review), PR 427 uses its own grading (CRITICAL and FR-8/FR-9 blocking, MAJOR blocking only with a concrete wrong outcome). A per-finding 427 re-grade of the baseline was not done. Use the same proxy for the re-run so the comparison is like for like, and also record 'all_findings'.
